title: Requirements Traceability
rules: Every high-priority requirement should link to an objective, user need, constraint, or documented obligation.
Every major proposed solution should explain which requirement it addresses.
Every implemented requirement should have defined acceptance criteria.
Acceptance criteria should be linked to appropriate test cases.
A passing test must have recorded evidence.
Requirements without supporting objectives or needs must be reviewed for necessity.
Objectives without associated requirements or an explicit non-website strategy must be flagged.
Changes to an objective or requirement should trigger an impact review of linked decisions and tests.

coverage_checks.check: High-priority requirements have a documented rationale.
Critical functionality has acceptance criteria and test coverage.
coverage_checks.failure_action: Block readiness for the affected release scope.

coverage_checks.check: Material scope changes have an impact assessment.
coverage_checks.failure_action: Require review before affected work proceeds.
